title: trichocentrum pachyphyllum
intro: Trichocentrum pachyphyllum, commonly known as the Yellow Egerton's Pansy or Yellow Butterfly Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and alleviating stress. Trichocentrum pachyllum is also believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-bacterial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-fungal properties, making it a sought-after ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
